title: Taiwanese Association of America 全美台灣同鄉會
content_html:
The Taiwanese Association of America (TAA, 全美台灣同鄉會) is a national nonprofit umbrella organization representing Taiwanese American community associations across the United States. Founded in 1970, the TAA serves as the coordinating body for its regional chapters, which are organized into five geographic divisions: Eastern Northern, Eastern Southern, Midwestern, Southern, and Western.

The TAA’s stated mission is to connect Taiwanese Americans, foster fellowship and cooperation, promote the welfare of the Taiwanese community in the United States, advocate for human rights and democratic values in Taiwan, and advance cultural exchange between Taiwan and America.

The organization holds an annual national conference and coordinates regional summer gatherings that bring together members from across its chapter network. As of 2025, the TAA comprises approximately 68 active chapters serving Taiwanese American communities in cities and states throughout the country.

The TAA has historically maintained a strong tradition of civic engagement, including advocacy related to Taiwan’s democratic development and the standing of Taiwanese Americans in public life. It is affiliated with the World Federation of Taiwanese Associations (WFTA), established in 1974.
